# Qdrant Service
[API index](index.md) | [Definition schema](schema.md)
| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `docker.qdrant.service` |
| Source | `09_docker/docker.qdrant.service.yaml` |
| Tags | docker, vector |
Qdrant vector database for similarity search and embedding storage. Exposes both
HTTP and gRPC APIs and persists collections under the bound data volume.
